thread:
maya (PM): quick sync — we got a few customer asks around doing multiple tool calls in one request. need a clear spec + launch checklist. who owns the decisions on ordering, retries, and timeouts?

sam (eng): basic problem statement: customers want 1) parallel invokes, 2) controlled ordering for some steps, 3) predictable retry semantics. tradeoffs: coordination adds latency.

igor (ml): also need to define merge semantics for model-facing outputs: do we present results as independent chunks or produce a single reconciled response? affects our KV cache + prompt windows.

lee (sre): from SLO side we need: per-request p95 for overall API, and per-subcall visibility. observability is a hard blocker for launch.

ash (solutions): two enterprise customers requested strict ordering (search -> rerank -> synth) and idempotent retries. they want audit logs for each subcall.

maya (PM): proposal draft: expose a "calls" array with per-call fields: timeout, retry_policy, ordering_hint. default is best-effort parallel. explicit ordering_hint opts into sequencing.

sam (eng): sketch API snippet:```json
{ "calls": [
  {"id":"c1","tool":"search","timeout_ms":5000},
  {"id":"c2","tool":"rerank","depends_on":["c1"],"retry":"idempotent"}
], "merge_strategy":"ordered-append" }
```

igor (ml): merge_strategy choices matter: ordered-append, prefer-high-score, dedupe-by-embedding. ML needs hooks for rerank scores and embeddings to avoid re-embedding on every subcall.

lee (sre): operationally we need: unique request id, per-call traces, per-call cost attribution, and fallbacks when a dependent call fails. otherwise customers see silent partial results.

sam (eng): retries: only allow automated retries for idempotent tools or when callers provide idempotency token. otherwise surface partial failure and let client retry.

maya (PM): launch criteria suggestion: 1) API contract spec published, 2) SDKs support calls array + examples, 3) console shows per-call latency/cost, 4) e2e tests including induced failures, 5) 2 pilot customers signed up, 6) security review for data flow.

ash (solutions): add: migration guide for customers using current toolcall patterns and a beta opt-in toggle for Dedicated/Hosted.

igor (ml): performance note — parallel + rerank will spike peak memory due to KV caches per subcall; add quantization / pooling guidance to optimize.

lee (sre): add chaos test in staging that kills one subcall VM and verifies graceful degradation + correct traces.

sam (eng): open engineering questions: a) do we co-locate dependent calls on same worker for zero-copy cache reuse? b) how do we express soft vs hard timeouts?

maya (PM): decision path: we should ship an "explicit-dependency" mode + default "parallel-best-effort". spec to include: per-call timeout_ms, retry_policy (none | idempotent | client), depends_on, idempotency_token.

sam (eng): agreeable. plan: 2-week spike to prototype orchestration, 3-week implementation, then 4-week beta with 2 customers.

maya (PM): priority: prod-safe semantics first (observability + idempotency), then perf optimizations (co-location, cache reuse).

product-bot: Reminder: create RFC doc in /docs and schedule RFC review on Thu.

ash (solutions): i'll curate pilot customer contracts and add audit-log requirements.

lee (sre): I'll draft the monitoring dashboard metrics we need.

sam (eng): I'll add a small example to the SDKs and a demo notebook.

maya (PM): thanks team. I'll assemble a launch checklist and share a one-pager by EOD. :thumbsup:
